# 在役退化与全寿命经济性

_In-Service Deterioration & Life-Cycle Economics_

在役性能把最初的性能基线与后续运行、维护和退化联系起来。评价一种方案时，还需要把燃料消耗、维护安排和成本边界放到整个使用阶段中考虑。

_In-service performance connects an initial baseline to subsequent operation, maintenance and deterioration. Evaluate fuel consumption, maintenance arrangements and cost boundaries over the service period._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 先排除工况、仪表和数据处理差异，再讨论性能趋势。

_Check operating conditions, instrumentation and data processing before interpreting performance trends._

- 将退化特征、维护事件和恢复效果与时间及使用经历关联。

_Link deterioration, maintenance events and recovery to time and service history._

- 经济性比较应明确任务、价格假设、使用强度和成本范围，并进行敏感性分析。

_State the mission, price assumptions, utilisation and cost scope, and examine sensitivity to those assumptions._

参考书主题对应：第 14–15 章。下文是本站导读，章节关联用于定位原书。

_Book topic mapping: Chapter(s) 14–15. The text here is a site-authored introduction; the chapter link locates the original discussion._
